items.summary: Handoff for EXEC_CONV_12: keep searchwoot.com private. Four launch-readiness tasks remain open; rights, retention, consent, vendor, accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. Continue the consolidated read-only evidence bundle and keep outreach unsent.

Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible internal evidence work. Recommendation: keep the private gate, keep permission outreach unsent, and authorize no rights-dependent display, alerts, affiliate/advertising monetization, tracking expansion, deployment, or external outreach. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses. Compliance is technical-only at 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Security and operations evidence remain incomplete, analytics data quality is yellow, and Amazon revenue is aggregate and unattributed. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent request or launch decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review the consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing evidence and smallest next actions are recorded below. Incomplete telemetry does not independently block ordinary fleet growth, but unavailable data must remain unknown and must not be treated as zero.

Fleet recommendation: retain containment-only execution. Continue existing measurement, finance attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, security evidence capture, and parked/private ownership verification. Do not create new production work, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spending, monetization changes, or outreach. The smallest next evidence action is to attach the consolidated SearchWoot evidence bundle; separately, site-factory should attach dated execution-owner evidence for complicated.work by 2026-09-30T17:00Z.

Continue the existing consolidated read-only launch-readiness evidence bundle and keep the gated property private. Rights, retention, consent, vendor, accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete; keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.
